I’m John Latham, a UK songwriter producer creating original songs for artists and recording projects. My work spans songwriting, arrangement and production. Book a session.

Discography

Let’s Make Some Songs

You can browse my catalogue of unreleased songs, book a writing session with me, or arrange a writing and production session.

I’ve been writing and producing songs professionally for over 10 years, releasing music through my own projects and collaborating with other artists. I’m looking to build relationships with a wider network of artists, record labels and publishing companies.

All of my music is registered with PRS, Sentric, ASCAP, Ditto, PPL and other music rights organisations. My focus is on songwriting, recording and developing original music.
